title: Book Two · Chapter 170: Leo's Own Choice
story:
Leo is not at lunch on Thursday. Ronan finds him later on the steps, with a small sheet from his family in his hand.

“More questions?” Ronan asks.

Leo folds the sheet. “We may visit the other school during the winter holiday.”

“You are going, then?”

“Just for a visit. I could go there next school year. We still need to decide where I will live.”

Ronan sits beside him. The step is warm from the sun.

“My mother wants me to see it myself,” Leo says. “My father has questions about the travel and the cost. I have questions about the classes.”

“A house full of questions again.”

“I am taking some back in.”

“What do you want to see there?” Ronan asks.

“The rooms when people are using them.”

“Not the empty chairs?”

“Not only those.”

Leo looks down at the sheet.

“And I want to ask a student about the day. Not just the teacher.”

“What will you ask?”

“What happens after the last lesson. How far it is to get home.”

Ronan thinks of their own walk from the gate. They can stop at Mr Qiu's table without asking the way.

“Your aunt will know the road.”

“Yes. I want to try it too.”

Ronan nods. He wants Leo to stay, but he can understand that part. A picture of a school does not show the whole walk from a bedroom to a classroom.

Leo smooths the paper on his knee. One corner keeps turning up, so he holds it down with his thumb.

Leo opens the family sheet. He has added three short questions at the bottom. Ronan reads them. One is about time for sport after lessons.

“That one is important,” Ronan says.

“You think I only read?”

“Your nose also holds leaves.”

Leo laughs and puts the sheet away.

For a while, they watch shadows move across the yard. Ronan wants to ask if Leo really needs the reading group place too. The thought feels ugly, but it stays with him.

“You will still do the final choice?” he asks.

“Of course.”

“Even with all this?”

Leo looks at him. “I want both things. I can do the reading work this year. I can visit a school for next year.”

“Yes.”

“I have time to do both.”

Ronan rubs the edge of the step with his shoe. “I know.”

He does know. Leo wants a place. He has the same right to try. The two chairs belong to no one yet.

Leo takes a sample page from his bag.

“Will you ask me these tomorrow?” he says. “I keep giving the time. Then I forget to say the room.”

Ronan takes the page. “After lunch?”

“Yes.”

“I can do that.”

Leo gets up for his next lesson. Ronan stays a moment longer. He looks toward the reading room wall. His name has four marks there, one more than it should.

The extra mark comes from the task Leo helped him finish. Ronan looks at Leo's new page. He wishes he could think only about this new practice.

At the classroom door, Leo calls back. “Bring it tomorrow. I need it.”

Ronan lifts the page to show that he hears. He puts it in his bag, beside the folder with the six original results. Then he follows Leo inside. The sample page stays beside his folder during the next lesson.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

travel＝来往交通；cost＝费用；both＝两者都；extra＝多出的。

## 理解问题

1. Leo为什么可以同时争取本学年的席位并考察下一阶段学校？
2. Ronan看着Leo的新练习页，为什么会想到那个额外记号？

## 读句子

**The two chairs belong to no one yet.**

拆开看：The two chairs / belong / to no one yet.

那两张椅子／目前还不属于／任何人。
